cases.name: wide
cases.when: responsive is false, or the container is at least --bp-md -- the default shape, a real role="grid" the arrow keys walk

cases.name: card
cases.when: responsive is true and the container is below --bp-md -- one card per row, no grid, row or cell role anywhere
cases.reason: Below the breakpoint there is no grid: the rows become stacked cards and nothing carries a grid, row or cell role. The grid pattern's requirements do not go unmet in this shape, they do not APPLY to it -- there is no grid for a roving tab stop to live in. Whether a card a consumer made clickable is reachable by keyboard is TableRow's question, not a clause of this one, and that binding records where this layer stands on it.
